summary: Shows tags on import_role and import_tasks apply to all imported tasks.
questions: How do I tag all tasks from an imported role or task file?

answer_card.title: Tags on imports
answer_card.answer_md:
Tags on static imports apply to **every imported task**:

```yaml
- import_role:
    name: foo
  tags: [bar, baz]
- import_tasks: foo.yml
  tags: [ web, foo ]
```
